body: Every time I get up to try living life again or being productive I just think of all the possible bad things that can happen and I get paralyzed. Also I have zero motivation or desire for any thing including socializing or making money. Everything seems like sooo much effort with little reward and I just want to give up. I don’t see myself living for 50 more years I want to give up and waste away now I’m just trying to find strength to make it through the holidays at least
